DIAGNOSIS READY: Cutaneous Leishmaniasis (post-tsetse/ant-bite transmission in an immunocompromised host).

The lesion's progression over one month with an ant bite history, combined with your immunosuppression from Crohn's and prior steroid use, strongly suggests an opportunistic parasitic infection rather than a simple bacterial abscess.
